newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FRUITFED SELLS HASTINGS PROPERTY.
newsitem.headline: FRUITFED SELLS HASTINGS PROPERTY.

text.p: Fruitfed Supplies said on Friday it had sold its premises at King St, Hastings, to a consortium of local business interests.
Settlement will be on August 13. A sale price was not disclosed.
"The sale will result in a small surplus over book value to the company," Fruitfed said in a statement.
Fruitfed's Hastings Branch will continue to operate from King St for the 1997-98 season and will move to new premises in the second quarter of 1998.
Negotiations were well advanced on a new base for the business in the Hawkes Bay, the company said.
